items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: And it was owned by Jack Schaefer.

ctx.x: Yeah, Catholic, that's what I thought. Could you tell us some more about that show, you say you went and played with shows and all that?

Well, my sister Edna and I went out on the show business. And when we left home, I was about 15 years of age. And the first show we went on was what's called Mighty Wiggle, Mighty Wiggle Carnival. And it was owned by Jack Schaefer.
Where did they travel? Florida or?
